verdict.rationale: Sift is a fraud-detection SaaS that ingests user event data, so controlling retention and deletion of that data is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack only covers sending data in (Events, Decisions, backfill) and scoring. Nothing documents retention settings, deletion APIs or data-erasure controls. The single privacy-related community comment voices hesitation about sharing personal data but says nothing about retention or deletion capabilities.
